question: Explain why integrated circuits have an important role in modern electronic devices. Mention the advantages related to miniaturisation, reliability and speed.

options.A: Integrated circuits are important because their components are widely separated, making devices large, slow and power-hungry.
options.B: Integrated circuits improve reliability by increasing the number of soldered joints and external wires.
options.C: Integrated circuits are useful only for reducing weight; they do not improve speed, power use or cost.
options.D: Integrated circuits place many components on a single small semiconductor chip. This miniaturises devices, reduces external connections and failures, shortens signal paths for high speed, lowers power consumption, and enables economical mass production. Hence they are essential for compact, fast and reliable modern electronics.
